name: dental-clinic-crm
description: Comprehensive dental clinic CRM and practice management system

scripts.setup:env: cd backend && if not exist .env (copy .env.example .env && echo Created backend/.env from .env.example) else (echo backend/.env already exists)
scripts.db:setup: cd backend && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npm run prisma:migrate reset --force
scripts.clean: cd backend && rmdir /s /q node_modules dist 2>nul & cd .. rontend && rmdir /s /q node_modules dist 2>nul & cd .. && rmdir /s /q node_modules 2>nul
scripts.update: git pull && npm install && npm run build
